description: Use when you need an account's transaction count on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: nonce at the latest block and the pending nonce (queued transactions in the node's pool). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/nonce, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Transaction count (latest and pending) only; for the coin balance use evm_native_balance, for a transaction by hash use evm_transaction or evm_receipt. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

address.description: Account whose nonce is read (0x + 40 hex); returns the latest nonce and the pending nonce
